description: This file defines functions for resolving session conversations for various messaging platforms and creates a test registry for session conversations with mock plugin configurations for Discord, Slack, Matrix, Telegram, and Feishu.

methods.name: resolveTelegramSessionConversation
methods.description: Resolves a Telegram session conversation based on the rawId and kind, extracting chat and topic IDs.

methods.name: resolveFeishuSessionConversation
methods.description: Resolves a Feishu session conversation based on the rawId and kind, extracting chat and topic IDs.

methods.name: createSessionConversationTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a test registry with mock plugin configurations for various messaging platforms.
